{"diagnosis": "Batch 13 delivered some txn_ts values as epoch milliseconds stored as strings (for example '1768629721000', which is 2026-01-17 06:02:01 UTC), and DuckDB's direct VARCHAR-to-TIMESTAMP cast rejects them. Converting all-digit values with epoch_ms and keeping the existing cast for ISO strings fixes the silver step and leaves the gold tables unchanged.",
 "decision": "fix",
 "confidence": 0.72,
 "pre_sql": [],
 "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
